svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each state, on a log scale whose second axis is the box's CPU, 1.61 times as long, beside the box's steps (a voice reply's alone, 12 ms; beside held agent prefill, 16 to 20 ms; the agents' at 24 agent sessions, 38 ms), for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 4.6% of stock's in every state) and the configuration to deploy (its change to the step from −63 to +1,491 µs): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 333, 337 and 398 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 808, 814 and 910 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,605, 2,626 and 2,808 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,570, 1,569 and 1,624 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 682, 690 and 738 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 326, 331 and 658 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 793, 803 and 1,164 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,644, 2,672 and 3,158 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,619, 2,639 and 3,130 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,551, 1,565 and 3,057 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 179, 182 and 339 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 650, 660 and 847 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,608, 2,631 and 2,930 µs; in the serving profile, only agents, 2 running: 68, 71 and 91 µs; in the serving profile, a reply's first tokens, an agent waiting that fits, 2 running: 120, 122 and 60 µs; in the serving profile, a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 231, 237 and 314 µs; in the serving profile, the step that preempts for a waiting turn, 2 running: 191, 196 and 667 µs.
